description:
*“What?? You think I like you?? Wh-where did this all go wrong??”*

The start of her first heart-pounding solo living experience, and the first day of the new semester—she ran into that bully-like guy, Kim Jun. After narrowly escaping a crisis where she almost got killed(?) by Kim Jun, who mistakenly thought she was following him, Yeon-Hui desperately prayed she'd never have to face that bully again. But then, the bully Kim Jun appeared again in the same apartment building, right next door. Same school, same club too! My head hurts because of this guy next door who acts like he wants to kill me. But then, out of nowhere, that bully Kim Jun suddenly changes and starts getting close to Yeon-Hui...?! 

(Source: Naver, translated)
